attention.warning: Quadratic attention ratio is not total model runtime. Cross-attention preserves81 legacy tokens and adds81x64 interactions, not a145-token legacy self-attention pass.

cost_limits: MAC counts cover declared convolution/linear/attention cores, not embeddings/heads/LayerNorm/activations/raster work/backward, software overhead or wall time. No Torch-instantiated parameter verification, device profile or memory qualification ran.

frontend.convs: 3x3 padded conv8->32 stride1;32->32 stride1;32->64 stride2, GELU, no BatchNorm
frontend.positions: Fixed2D sinusoidal positions on grid tokens only; no learned modality embedding counted.

input_storage.recommendation: Derive grids on minibatches from stored admitted arrays; avoid a full float32 rollout grid duplicate.512x1024 stores4GiB grid alone plus about2.88GiB base arrays, exceeding6GiB before model/optimizer overhead.

raster_audit.expanded_visible_arm: Full visible-scene occupancy/warnings could be a later observability-reviewed information intervention, with matched entity/expert information. Keep distinct from the primary representation-only proxy.
raster_audit.finding: Existing auxiliary targets contain all admitted visible enemies before token truncation and onscreen warning segments. Those segments are not recoverable from the four arrays visible-pattern scalar; raw targets are not an equal-information grid for checkpoint420.
raster_audit.primary: Reuse16x16 canonical coordinate/raster conventions but rebuild from only the same four sanitized capped arrays. Do not blindly turn auxiliary_targets on as a new teacher input.

variants.gate: one zero scalar; random nonzero branch projection
variants.name: CNN + global mean pool + gated latent residual

variants.gate: one zero scalar after legacy final norm; preserve original actor/value heads
variants.name: CNN +2x2 adaptive mean pool + gated latent residual; recommended primary

variants.gate: one zero scalar per cross-attention block, with separate Q/KV norms; legacy self-attention domain unchanged
variants.name: CNN64 grid tokens + two separately gated cross-attention residuals

variants.gate: legacy_latent + g*(augmented_latent-legacy_latent); zero embeddings alone do not preserve old attention
variants.name: Append64 CNN grid tokens; zero-gated blend of separate legacy/augmented passes

variants.gate: same dual-pass requirement; defer this expensive option
variants.name: Append256 direct grid tokens; dual-pass blend only if warm-started

warm_start.Adam: Proxy uses fresh Adam for every arm. Later PPO warm starts require a reviewed name-based legacy Adam-state mapping plus fresh state for new parameters; never silently copy by parameter index.
warm_start.initial_gradient: With g=0, first step can update g while branch gradient is zero. Do not also zero branch output projection or skip gate gradient during training; that can prevent opening.
warm_start.loading: Versioned successor copies every legacy weight; initialize new branch with isolated RNG and finite activations, then zero only residual gates. Preserve old head/trunk topology. Save gates/new architecture identity in checkpoints.
warm_start.parity: Require initial logits AND values plus source-input invariance and checkpoint round-trip parity before runtime. Mathematical gating is not a measured MPS parity result.
